{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Grom 1''''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Assassin-class corvette]] which together with its sister ship, the ''[[Grom 2]]'', accompanied the ''[[Anat]]'' on its ill-fated [[Battle near the Blair Cluster|final trip]] near the [[Blair Cluster/Legends|Blair Cluster]]. Upon being pulled out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] and [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'', the ''Grom 1'' was ordered to engage. It met its end at the hand of Imperial torpedoes along with the ''Grom 2'' and, soon after, the ''Anat''.
